description_en: Clears the driver configurations of an edge instance
description_zh: 清空边缘实例驱动配置
kebab_example: aliyun iot clear-edge-instance-driver-configs --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --driver-id 021d154d2a2f4dd7a489773d9e040000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ClearEdgeInstanceDriverConfigs

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the driver. On the **Driver Management** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target driver name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
驱动ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**驱动管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html接口获取
parameters.name: driver_id
